baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison لا تجعلوا دعاء الرسول بينكم كدعاء بعضكم بعضا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prohibited act is making or classifying one speech relation as another: a call borne by a messenger is leveled into reciprocal traffic among peer-parts. The comparison therefore concerns the call's force and relation, not only its sound or wording.

activation_trace.role: Rendering something into a status supplies the prohibited leveling of one kind of call into another.
A spoken call bends an addressee toward response and supplies both sides of the comparison.
A bearer and borne message give the first call transmitted rather than merely personal force.
A connective relation among parties locates the speech act inside the community's social bond.
Part-to-part reciprocity defines ordinary horizontal speech against which the messenger-bearing call is measured.

changed_reading.before: The clause only prescribes a more respectful way to address the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: The clause first forbids treating a messenger-bearing summons as interchangeable with horizontally reciprocal peer speech; respectful address remains a live secondary reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يتسللون منكم لواذا ثم يخالفون عن أمره.
baseline_models.mechanism: A member is softly extracted from among the group while another person supplies concealment; مخالفة then names the resulting path-divergence away from binding direction. The verse depicts coordinated concealment rather than a merely private absence.

activation_trace.role: A gentle, hidden drawing-out gives the withdrawal its low-visibility extraction motion.
Sheltering behind another person turns fellow members into moving cover for the exit.
Taking a route unlike another's converts concealed movement into directional opposition.
A binding request supplies the direction from which the covert route departs.

changed_reading.after: People peel themselves out of the collective by using one another as cover, converting the shared body into an exit mechanism from binding direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated incidence in أن تصيبهم فتنة أو يصيبهم عذاب أليم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated target-hitting distinguishes two consequence modes. Fitna can assay and expose quality or bend a person from the course, whereas the alternative explicitly inflicts painful punishment. Opposition thus risks both destabilizing diagnosis and manifest sanction.

activation_trace.role: Directed arrival at a target makes both alternatives concrete incidences rather than abstract liabilities.
Assaying a person as metal is assayed makes the first impact diagnostic and revealing.
Deflection from a true course lets the first impact name further destabilization as well as testing.
Punitive infliction supplies the overt sanction contrasted with the more diagnostic fitna.
The capacity to cause pain marks the second consequence as experientially manifest.

changed_reading.before: Those who disobey may receive a generic punishment.
changed_reading.after: Divergence exposes them either to an assay that reveals or destabilizes them, or to an overtly painful penal impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier speech crisis shows an utterance being received into tongues, emitted by mouths without knowledge, and diffused through the community until it carries painful consequence. Against that mechanism, making the Messenger's call into ordinary part-to-part calling risks converting a bounded message into a peer relay that can detach wording from knowledge and force.

activation_trace.role: The two spoken calls anchor the distinction between an authoritative source and ordinary relay.
Message-bearing office supplies the channel whose integrity peer transmission could flatten.
Part-to-part structure supplies the horizontal relay topology.
Taking and receiving speech supplies the first handoff in the uncontrolled relay.
The speaking organ materializes transmission from person to person.
Voiced assertion without knowledge shows how a relay can preserve speech while losing warrant.
Diffusion and dispersal turn repeated peer speech into a community-scale effect.
The same punitive field links harmful speech diffusion to the focus warning.
The repeated painful quality closes the lexical bridge to the focus consequence.

structural_cues: 24:15 reverses the speakers' estimate of relayed speech as light against its greatness before God.
24:19 repeats the painful-punishment pair found in the focus ayah after describing harmful diffusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a peer relay, diffusion, and repeated consequence wording; I infer that recoding the Messenger's call as ordinary peer speech exposes it to the same distortion network. A live alternative is that the echo reinforces seriousness without specifying channel integrity.

changed_reading.before: The first clause distinguishes rank or etiquette in direct address.
changed_reading.after: It also protects a message-bearing call from becoming ordinary peer-to-peer circulation in which speech can detach from knowledge, authority, and accountable source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, legitimate passage through a social boundary is mediated by recognition, permission, and willingness to return. The immediately preceding collective matter applies the same protocol to departure. Slipping away under another person's cover is therefore the egress-side inverse of unauthorized entry: it bypasses a boundary whose purpose is to keep presence and absence accountable.

activation_trace.role: Hidden extraction supplies an unannounced crossing out of the collective.
Another member serves as cover that defeats the visibility expected at a boundary.
Crossing into an interior supplies the ingress case governed by prior social recognition.
Explicit authorization makes passage a granted relation rather than a unilateral act.
Returning when refused models compliance with a closed boundary.
Joining dispersed members into one matter creates the collective interior from which departure matters.
Repeated requests and grants of leave establish the authorized egress protocol directly before the focus.
A person's own concern supplies a legitimate exception that must still pass through permission.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 regulate entry, recognition, permission, return, and knowledge of concealed conduct.
24:58-59 repeat permission at private thresholds, and 24:62 transfers the protocol to leaving a collective matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regulated ingress, private thresholds, and permission-governed egress; I infer a common access-control ethic and read covert departure as its deliberate bypass. The narrower alternative is that only 24:62, not the household rules, governs the focus.

changed_reading.before: The sliders are rude attendees who leave a meeting secretly.
changed_reading.after: Their exit is the inverse of unauthorized entry: a covert breach of the surah's permission-mediated boundaries that turns accountable presence into hidden absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly pairs concealment with traces that make conduct knowable. Hidden adornment can be disclosed by bodily movement, and the closing ayah turns known deeds into a report. Divine knowledge of those sliding away thus functions not only as omniscience despite secrecy but as forensic differentiation: covert motion itself becomes a mark.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark shifts knowing toward identification by a readable trace.
Low-visibility extraction supplies the conduct whose trace is being distinguished.
Active hiding supplies the surah's explicit counterpart to disclosure and divine knowledge.
Knowledge produced by a bodily sign demonstrates how concealed status becomes legible through movement.
Concealment supplies the hidden object whose accidental sign defeats secrecy.
A delivered report converts already known conduct into disclosed account.
Intentional deeds identify what the closing report will expose.

structural_cues: 24:29 pairs what people disclose and conceal with divine knowledge.
24:31 makes something hidden knowable through bodily motion, while 24:64 encloses the focus with knowledge, return, and report of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, bodily signs, knowledge, and final reporting; I infer that the sliders' motion is itself an evidentiary trace. The live alternative is a simpler assertion of omniscience with no forensic emphasis.

changed_reading.before: God sees the deserters even though they successfully hide from people.
changed_reading.after: Their concealment is not evidentially blank: the patterned act of sliding behind others marks and differentiates them, and the closing report will make that hidden alignment explicit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weather sequence gathers separate bodies, stacks them, opens gaps, sends down matter, and directs or diverts its impact. Repetition of the same incidence root in the focus lets that material sequence activate the warning: people may aggregate into cover and seek gaps for escape, but the threatened fitna or punishment has directed reach that social layering cannot redirect.

activation_trace.role: Taking cover behind another supplies the human attempt to interpose a layer.
The repeated target-hit carries the weather sequence's directionality into both threatened outcomes.
Joining one thing to another supplies aggregation before the descent.
Stacking bodies one over another supplies a material analogue for protective social layering.
Descending rain makes consequence emerge from the aggregate rather than remain abstract.
A gap between bodies supplies the passage through which what descends reaches below.
Descent from above gives the shared incidence verb a vertical material profile.
Arrival at a selected target supplies the precise impact echoed in the focus.
Turning an impact away establishes that diversion belongs to divine direction, not the target's improvised cover.

structural_cues: 24:63 repeats the incidence verb for both fitna and punishment after depicting people sheltering behind one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the meteorological sequence and the repeated s-w-b verb; I map its causal geometry onto the social warning. This is a cross-domain inference, and the live alternative is that the shared verb contributes only ordinary target semantics.

changed_reading.before: Fitna or punishment may happen to the offenders at some later point.
changed_reading.after: The warning has the geometry of directed incidence: layered human cover and exploitable gaps cannot divert an impact whose target and turning are controlled beyond the group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence defines the relevant call functionally: people are called to God and the Messenger for judgment between them, a faction turns away, and believers answer by hearing and obeying. The Messenger bears delivery while the addressees bear response. This sharply favors the Messenger's authoritative summons over a reading limited to forms of address.

activation_trace.role: A call that draws its addressee supplies the focus comparison now clarified by the judgment scenes.
The bearer of a delivered message anchors authority in transmission rather than personal prestige alone.
Binding direction connects the summons to the warned-against departure.
Turning the back after a claim of obedience supplies the overt precursor to covert withdrawal.
The call draws parties toward a specified adjudicative response.
Judgment between people identifies the institutional work performed by the summons.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the call's expected uptake.
Willing submission completes the response that peer-negotiable speech does not require.
Delivering a message defines the Messenger's assigned side of the communication relation.

structural_cues: 24:47-48 move from professed obedience to turning away specifically when a call seeks judgment.
24:51-54 pair the same call with hearing, obedience, guidance, allocated responsibility, and clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calls to adjudication, opposed responses, and the Messenger's delivery role; I infer that دعاء الرسول in 24:63 primarily denotes his summons or the summons carried through him. The objective-genitive reading about how people call him remains grammatically live.

changed_reading.before: Do not address the Messenger as casually as you address one another.
changed_reading.after: Do not process his judgment-bearing summons as a negotiable peer request that may be ignored when its outcome is inconvenient; address etiquette remains compatible but no longer exhausts the clause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing social rules explicitly permit mutual circulation, eating together or separately, and personal concerns within a gathered body. They therefore do not erase horizontal peer relations; they delimit them. The focus distinction protects one non-peer channel inside that otherwise reciprocal network, and covert exit corrupts the network by using mutual proximity as cover rather than acknowledged circulation.

activation_trace.role: The compared calls anchor the distinction between bounded summons and ordinary social exchange.
Parts addressing parts supply the horizontal network whose legitimacy and limit are being defined.
The bond among parties holds the authoritative channel inside, rather than outside, communal relations.
Circling repeatedly around others supplies ordinary household mobility.
Part-over-part proximity gives the focus comparison a concrete social topology.
Joining dispersed people legitimizes collective participation.
Dispersal remains a legitimate social mode when it is open rather than covert.
An individual concern marks a recognized local claim within the collective matter.

structural_cues: 24:58 describes ordinary part-over-part circulation while preserving timed privacy boundaries.
24:61 allows both gathering and dispersion, and 24:62 recognizes a personal concern through explicit leave.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate reciprocal traffic, gathering, dispersion, and bounded personal exceptions; I infer that 24:63 distinguishes authority within reciprocity rather than abolishing peer equality. The alternative is that the repeated بعض language is merely idiomatic and adds no topology.

changed_reading.before: The Messenger is simply elevated above everyone else in an undifferentiated hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: The surah preserves dense peer reciprocity while reserving a distinct response-channel for the Messenger's summons; the fault is flattening that channel or exploiting peer proximity to evade it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the derived forms of x-l-f and places the promise of succession beside the warning about divergence. It remains anchored in يخالفون and in the packet's recurrence of the same root at 24:55, but downstream prose should present it only as a polarity activated by the shared root, not as an equation of the two forms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The x-l-f form in يخالفون عن أمره.

activation_trace.role: Taking a different route supplies the negative pole of departing from entrusted direction.
Authority and office make the divergent route relevant to communal entrustment.
Coming after and standing in another's place supplies the positive pole of authorized continuity.
Granted capacity and establishment identify what faithful successors are enabled to bear.

changed_reading.before: Opponents violate a discrete instruction and incur an external penalty.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory root-polarity level, taking another route from the command also marks failure to remain in the line capable of bearing authorized succession and established responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's non-dominant resolution maps quranic s-w-b to an n-s-b branch, which is form-distant from ordinary incidence. It remains anchored in the twice-repeated تصيب construction and the explicit fitna-punishment objects; downstream prose must treat it as a material overlay on befalling, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two target-incidence verbs تصيبهم and يصيبهم.

activation_trace.role: An exhausting imposed ordeal turns the impact into sustained attrition rather than only a punctual blow.
Assay under pressure keeps the ordeal tied to the verse's first explicit consequence.
Pain-inflicting force keeps the overlay bounded by the second explicit consequence.

changed_reading.before: A consequence strikes at a moment.
changed_reading.after: The impact may also unfold as an imposed, exhausting ordeal that tests resistance over time, while the ordinary sense of befalling remains primary.

strongest_changes: 24:47-54 shifts دعاء الرسول from a reading exhausted by address etiquette toward an authoritative, judgment-bearing summons answered by hearing and obedience.
The entry, privacy, and assembly rules make covert withdrawal an egress-side breach of a permission-mediated boundary.
The concealment and knowledge pattern makes stealth evidentiary, while 24:43 gives the repeated incidence verb an exploratory geometry of directed impact.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined speech diffusion, domestic thresholds, collective permission, bodily traces, reciprocal social traffic, and directed weather without forcing them into one interpretation. It preserved the address-etiquette reading while recovering institutional, forensic, spatial, and material mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: دعاء الرسول remains grammatically open between the Messenger's summons, a summons carried through him, and the community's manner of calling him.
The antecedent and scope of أمره remain open between the Messenger and God, and between a particular command, authoritative direction, and the matter at hand.
The weather geometry, x-l-f polarity, and non-dominant n-s-b overlay are branch-anchored but intentionally exploratory rather than final interpretations.
